$comment: Fingerprints of every sample in test-output/. Regenerate deliberately with `npx tsx scripts/verify-samples.ts --update`, and say why in the release notes: a changed hash means existing output changed. Mode `bytes` is a SHA-256 of the file; mode `semantic` is a SHA-256 of a canonical projection of the decrypted document, used for encrypted samples whose bytes are CSPRNG-derived and can never repeat. Each entry's `since` names the release whose output the hash is: it is carried forward untouched while the sample is unchanged, and moves to the release doing the rebaseline when the hash changes, so the chain 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0 stays auditable and every re-anchoring is visible in the diff.
provenance: The 1.7.0 entries were verified against a v1.7.0 git worktree carrying only the determinism plumbing (pinned creation instant, TZ=UTC). Entries stamped 1.8.0 are, in order: the 29 samples introduced by 1.8.0; the nine whose v1.7.0 output was non-deterministic by construction (a Math.random() fixture, an unpinned incremental /ModDate, seven signature samples whose /M and CMS signingTime defaulted to the wall clock); and the samples whose output 1.8.0 changed deliberately — Khmer, Myanmar, Lao, Tai Tham, New Tai Lue, Tai Le and Cham shaping, COLRv1 emoji (transforms, then the alpha-ramp layers), regenerated font modules, the no-break-space metric fix (three compression samples), the base-14 measurement fix (text-extract-report, table-micro-columns), the no-break-space glyph fix (four pdfa-latin samples), the English-only pass over sample prose (digital-signature-info, then the three typography samples that demonstrated hyphenation on French words), the 27 alphabet plates (column widths and neutral labels), the four printer's-marks samples (clearance and colour bars) and every sample embedding a TrueType face whose source carries hinting tables (prep, fpgm, cvt, gasp are now kept in the subset; outlines unchanged). The eight embedded-font samples still held to 1.7.0 (Greek, Polish, Turkish, Vietnamese) use subset modules whose source has none of those tables. Every re-anchoring is listed in the 1.8.0 release note. Counts: 1.7.0=122, 1.8.0=149.
